course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Recycle B2 word order and time expressions while rearranging a busy day.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two adults coordinate errands, an appointment, and travel time on a crowded weekday.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Summarizing a changed schedule and agreeing on a practical order of actions.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik compare the original plan with a changed weekday schedule involving an errand, a delayed bus, and an appointment.

main_focus.name: main-clause inversion after time and place fronting
main_focus.description: Use fronted time or place phrases with reliable V2 word order when explaining a changed plan.
model_examples: Efter jobbet går jag först till apoteket.
I centrum hinner vi kanske äta något snabbt.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use fronted time or place phrases naturally 4-5 times across the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: present tense and future with ska
avoid_grammar: formal written passives as the main pattern

useful_chunks: I så fall hinner vi inte...
Vi kan ta det i den här ordningen.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use most active words and chunks if they fit naturally, with emphasis on practical scheduling.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker explains that the original plan no longer works because of a delay or extra errand.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare two possible orders, using fronted time and place phrases to keep the plan clear.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a revised order and one fallback if the appointment runs late.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat fronted time/place frames naturally without making the dialogue mechanical

focus: the situation/context of the changed schedule
the reason the original plan no longer works
the revised order of actions that is agreed

sentence_focus: one sentence starting with Efter jobbet and correct V2 word order
one sentence starting with I centrum and a modal verb
one sentence explaining a delay with eftersom
one sentence about booking something again
one sentence summarizing the final order of the errands
